content.comment_body: How can I perform a factory reset on a [product_name] [version_no] basic module that does not have a display?
You can use the [product_name] software for this. Go to Tools > Transfer > Factory Reset.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for instructions on resetting a [product_name] [version_no] basic module without a display. The solution involves using the associated [product_name] software, showing that hardware limitations require software-based actions and that users depend on software tools for functions not directly available on the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates a straightforward way to reset the [product_name] [version_no] basic module to factory settings, whether through hardware or software, even if the module lacks a display.
